spans.s: mf(आ)n. (in Uṇ. iii, 19 said to be fr. √ श्लिष्) slippery, smooth, polished, even, soft, tender, gentle, bland, AV. &c. &c.
small, minute, thin, slim, fine (cf. comp.), L.
honest, sincere, W.
N. of a mountain, Divyāv.
(आ), f. N. of a river, ib.
(अम्), ind. softly, gently, MBh.; R.
श्लक्ष्ण—तर mfn. more or most slippery or smooth &c., R.
श्लक्ष्ण—ता f. smoothness, Cat.
श्लक्ष्ण—तीक्ष्णाग्र mfn. having a thin and sharp point, L.
श्लक्ष्ण—त्वच् m. ‘having a smooth bark’, Bauhinia Tomentosa, L.
श्लक्ष्ण—पत्त्रक m. ebony, Diospyros Ebenaster, L.
श्लक्ष्ण—पिष्ट mfn. ground fine, Suśr.
श्लक्ष्ण—रूप-समन्वित mfn. having a smooth (or slender) form (applied to the sacrificial post), R.
श्लक्ष्ण—वाच् f. kindly speaking, L.
श्लक्ष्ण—वादिन् mfn. speaking softly or gently, ib.
श्लक्ष्ण—शिला f. a smooth or slippery stone, Suśr.
mf(इका)n. (= श्लक्ष्ण) slippery, smooth, AV.
making slippery, smoothing, polishing, KātyŚr.

Nom. P. ˚यति, to make slippery, smooth, polish, ib.;
to make thin or small, MW.
in comp. for श्लक्ष्ण.
श्लक्ष्णी—करण n. smoothing, Nyāyam., Sch.
a means or method of polishing, ĀpŚr.
श्लक्ष्णी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to smooth, polish, ĀpŚr.; TS., Sch.
bearing a small load g. वंशादि.
id. g. वंशादि
= श्लक्ष्णम् अधीते वेद वा, g. उक्थादि.
See उच्-छ्लख॑.
(cf. √ श्रङ्क्) cl. 1. Ā. श्लङ्कते, to go, move, Dhātup. iv, 11.
(cf. √ श्रङ्ग्) cl. 1. P. श्लङ्गति, to go, move, Dhātup. v, 45.
loose, relaxed, flaccid, weak, feeble, languid, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
untied, unfastened, Kāv.; Kathās.
dishevelled (as hair), W.
श्लथ—त्व n. looseness, laxity, Sāh.
श्लथ—बन्धन mfn. having the muscles relaxed, Ṛtus.
श्लथ—लम्बिन् mfn. hanging loosely, Kum.
श्लथ—शिल mfn. covered with a loose stone (as a well), VarYogay.
श्लथ—संधि mfn. having weak joints (-ता f.), Vāgbh.
श्लथ—संधि—ता f.
having relaxed or languid limbs (-ता f.), Bhartṛ.
श्लथाङ्ग—ता f.
having feeble or slight regard to (loc.), Prab.
relaxing one's effort, Bhartṛ.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become loose or relaxed, MBh.

श्लथी-√ कृ P. -करोति (p.p. -कृत), to make loose, relax, Amar.;
to diminish, Kathās.
N. of an Arhat, Buddh.
(cf. 2. श्रवण; श्रोण) lame, limping, PañcavBr.
(cf. √ शाख्) cl. 1. P. श्लाखति, to pervade, penetrate, Dhātup. v, 13.
boasting, a boaster, MBh.
or f(आ). the act of flattering, praise, eulogy, Sāh.
to be praised, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
श्लाघनीय—तर mfn. more (or most) praiseworthy &c., R.
श्लाघनीय—ता f. praiseworthiness, Kāv.
vaunt, boasting, MBh. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 1, 134)
flattery, praise, commendation, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 4, 34, Kāś.)
pleasure or delight in anything, Jātakam.
service, obedience, L.
wish, desire, L.
श्लाघा—वह mfn. meriting praise.
flattered, praised, commended, BhP.
boasting or proud of (comp.), Hariv.; R.
haughty (as a lion), BhP.
celebrated, famous for (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(ifc.) praising, celebrating, R. (cf. आत्म-श्ल्˚) = शालिन्, Divyāv.
desiring, MW.
highly praised or celebrated, BhP.
= श्लाघनीय (अम् ind.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
ind.
श्लाघ्य—तम (BhP.) mfn. most praiseworthy or laudable &c.
श्लाघ्य—तर (Ragh.) mfn. more praiseworthy or laudable &c.
श्लाघ्य—ता f. praiseworthiness, Kām.
श्लाघ्य—यौवना f. (a woman) in the glorious bloom of youth, Ratnāv.
descended from a honourable family, Mālatīm.
